title: Frontend Engineer
jd:
We're looking for a Frontend Engineer to join our team and help shape the future of online commerce.

You'll work on building and improving web products that millions of users interact with daily. You'll collaborate closely with product, design, and backend teams.

Responsibilities:
• Build and ship high-quality user interfaces
• Collaborate with designers to implement pixel-perfect UIs
• Write clean, maintainable TypeScript and React code
• Participate in code reviews and design discussions
• Optimize for performance and accessibility

Requirements:
• 3+ years of frontend experience
• Strong proficiency in React, TypeScript
• Experience with CSS and modern styling approaches
• Knowledge of web performance optimization
• Experience with REST APIs and GraphQL
